description: Shows how earnrate identifies a merchant: its spend category, likely MCC, which card networks it takes, confidence, and whether that came from curated data, Claude, or nowhere. Use it to explain or double-check a recommendation.

category.description: Only for a merchant earnrate may not know, and only if you're confident what kind of business it is: its spending category, e.g. grocery.supermarket for a supermarket, dining for a restaurant, gas for a gas station. Ignored when earnrate knows the merchant. Leave it out if unsure. Categories: dining (Restaurants), dining.fast_food (Fast food), grocery.supermarket (Supermarkets), grocery.online (Online grocery and delivery), superstore (Superstores), warehouse_club (Warehouse clubs), convenience_store (Convenience stores), gas (Gas stations), gas.grocery_store (Gas at grocery stores), gas.superstore (Gas at superstores and warehouse clubs), ev_charging (EV charging), transit (Transit), transit.rideshare (Rideshare and taxis), travel (Travel), travel.flights (Flights), travel.hotels (Hotels), travel.car_rental (Car rental), travel.cruise (Cruises), streaming (Streaming services), tv_internet (TV and internet service), phone (Cell phone service), utilities (Home utilities), drugstore (Drugstores and pharmacies), movie_theaters (Movie theaters), entertainment (Live entertainment and events), fitness (Gyms and fitness), department_store (Department stores), clothing (Clothing stores), electronics (Electronics stores), sporting_goods (Sporting goods stores), home_improvement (Home improvement), furniture (Furniture stores), online_retail (Online retail), office_supply (Office supply stores), shipping (Shipping and couriers), online_advertising (Social media and search advertising), other (Everything else).

channel.description: How the purchase is made. Omit if unknown; the answer says what it assumed.

merchant.description: Merchant name or web address as the user would say it or see it, e.g. "Whole Foods" or "delta.com", or a kind of place, e.g. "restaurants" or "gas station".
